The stock has been rated as a Strong Buy, as per Seeking Alpha’s quant rating, with a score of 4.96 out of 5. NVDA has been rated an A+ for growth and profitability, while it has been graded a C- for valuation.
Wall Street analysts have also issued a Strong Buy call, while Seeking Alpha analysts have rated the stock as Buy.

Seeking Alpha analyst  Simple Investment Ideas reiterated its Buy rating on the stock on the back of its current trajectory of earnings growth and valuations that, the analyst says, provides an adequate margin for execution error.
It believes that Nvidia's competitive advantage is evolving beyond GPUs and CUDA into a self-reinforcing, capital-based ecosystem.
“NVDA’s strategic investments, supply commitments, and financing partnerships are creating a self-reinforcing flywheel that deepens its ecosystem and drives recurring demand,” the analyst said.

However, another investor, Blue Harbinger, rated the stock as Hold, warning that many of the hottest AI stocks may come crashing down hard or just fade away as the industry shifts—similar to the internet bubble.
